I am a Junior Engineering student at **Harvey Mudd College** passionate about electrical engineering and hardware design. My technical interests range from digital system design with **microprocessors** and FPGAs to **Radio Frequency (RF) circuitry** and signal processing.

Outside the lab, you can find me running around Southern California or catching up on movies.
